title: Manuals
summary: What works for this person in one situation, written up by the coach as a page.

requirements.text: Only an index of manuals rides in the coach's prompt; the coach reads a manual when it applies.
A manual tied to a situation the app can see (a running fast) is given to the coach in full while that situation holds.
The user can edit a manual, and the coach keeps the user's words as written.
Every change to a manual keeps the version it replaced.
